# sophosfirewall_schedule (Resource)

Manages a schedule (*System > Profiles > Schedule*). Firewall rules and policies reference schedules by name to restrict when they apply. A `recurring` schedule repeats every week in its time slots; a `oneTime` schedule applies in its time slots between `start_date` and `end_date`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A weekly schedule, e.g. for rules that only apply during office hours.
resource "sophosfirewall_schedule" "office_hours" {
  name        = "Office-Hours"
  description = "Weekdays 08:00-18:00, Saturday mornings"
  type        = "recurring"

  time_slots = [
    { day_of_week = "weekdays", start_time = "08:00", end_time = "18:00" },
    { day_of_week = "sat", start_time = "09:00", end_time = "13:00" },
  ]
}

# A one-time maintenance window.
resource "sophosfirewall_schedule" "maintenance" {
  name       = "Maintenance-2026-12"
  type       = "oneTime"
  start_date = "2026-12-24 00:00:00"
  end_date   = "2026-12-27 00:00:00"

  time_slots = [
    { day_of_week = "allDays", start_time = "00:00", end_time = "23:59" },
  ]
}

# Firewall rules reference schedules by name.
resource "sophosfirewall_firewall_rule" "guest_web" {
  name              = "guest-web-office-hours"
  source_zones      = ["LAN"]
  destination_zones = ["WAN"]
  services          = ["HTTP", "HTTPS"]
  schedule          = sophosfirewall_schedule.office_hours.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name of the schedule.
- `time_slots` (Attributes Set) Time windows in which the schedule is active (1-256). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--time_slots))
- `type` (String) Schedule type. One of `recurring`, `oneTime`. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `end_date` (String) End of a `oneTime` schedule in the firewall's local time, formatted `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`. Must be after `start_date`. Required when `type` is `oneTime`, not allowed otherwise.
- `start_date` (String) Start of a `oneTime` schedule in the firewall's local time, formatted `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`. Required when `type` is `oneTime`, not allowed otherwise.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the object assigned by the firewall.

<a id="nestedatt--time_slots"></a>
### Nested Schema for `time_slots`

Required:

- `day_of_week` (String) Day or days the slot applies to. One of `allDays`, `sun`, `mon`, `tue`, `wed`, `thu`, `fri`, `sat`, `weekdays`, `weekdaysWithSaturday`.
- `end_time` (String) End of the slot, formatted `HH:MM` (24-hour). Must be after `start_time`.
- `start_time` (String) Start of the slot, formatted `HH:MM` (24-hour).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by name or UUID.
terraform import sophosfirewall_schedule.example <name-or-uuid>
```
